cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a handmade cloth doll dressed in Garifuna-style masquerade attire (mask, ribbons, feathered bandana, shell decoration) attributed by the museum to a Garifuna maker, consistent with known Garifuna dance/mask costume traditions.

physical.title: doll
physical.summary: Doll; sewn from cloth; man made of brown stuffed synthetic; wears tunic and pants sewn from white cotton; pink silk ribbon crossed over chest; green silk ribbon around knees, with white cotton on top decorated with white shells; pink cotton scarf wrapped around head; fuchsia wire mesh mask over face, painted with white eyes outlined in black and black mouth; yellow, green and burgundy striped cotton bandana wrapped around top of head, decorated with red glass jewel and two silver foil circles; feathers glued to inside of bandana.
